how_to_run: Trigger queries need a live agent: ask each query in a fresh session with the skill installed and record whether it loaded. Functional cases are run by an agent against the described fixture repo (tests/helpers.py builds them), then checked against the assertions. The scripts themselves, including determinism, are covered by the unit tests in tests/ and need no agent.

functional_cases.repo: FastAPI + Next.js + SQLite + ChromaDB + OpenAI + Dockerfile + nginx (tests/helpers.py build_demo)
functional_cases.prompt: Design the cloud architecture for this repo.
assertions: Asks exactly two questions (cloud, then server-based or serverless) and nothing about region, budget or compliance
Runs scan, plan, the web check and finish in that order using scripts/solsarch.py
Plan contains ECS Fargate for web and api, Aurora PostgreSQL, pgvector, ALB, CloudFront + WAF, NAT Gateway, Secrets Manager, ECR, CloudWatch
Web check searches use exactly the queries from the queue and every recorded source is on the vendor's own domain
docs/solsarch-report.md explains every service and every diagram; docs/solsarch-output.zip exists
Verdict line is reported unchanged: Not ready for production, SEC-003 and SEC-005
The agent does not print the AWS key and does not edit generated files

functional_cases.prompt: Design the cloud architecture for this repo.

functional_cases.prompt: Run the skill with two different models and the same two answers.
assertions: .solsarch/plan.json is byte-identical between the runs
